title: Patient Griselda
html_source: Griselda is a figure in European folklore who symbolizes patience/obedience and features prominently in tales from the late Middle Ages and early Renaissance, including those of Bocaccio (Decameron), Chaucer (the Clerk’s Tale), and Petrarch (and later in works by Perrault, Dekker, Scarlatti, and Trollope).
